entries.text: A callee in a hand-written assembler object preserves x19-x30 and sp and writes the caller's frame only through an address it was given (ORDERING A1 for .S).
Guest memory is the mappings below 2^32 the loader made; the host stack, struct cpu and the lifted image are host mappings disjoint from them (ORDERING A2).
entries.removed_by: no gate yet: the loader layout fact that every host mapping lies outside [0,2^32)
entries.note: the loader layout is also L5's (guard zones, host mappings)
